title: 1989 AMC 8 Problem 23
statement: An artist has \(14\) cubes, each with an edge of \(1\) meter. She stands them on the ground to form a sculpture as shown. She then paints the exposed surface of the sculpture. How many square meters does she paint?

solutions.text:
Because each higher layer is flush into one corner, each of the four vertical sides shows a stepped profile of \(3 + 2 + 1 = 6\) exposed square faces, for \(4 \times 6 = 24\) side faces.

Viewed from directly above, the top faces cover the full \(3 \times 3\) footprint, adding \(9\) more faces. The bottom rests on the ground and is not painted, so the total is \(24 + 9 = 33\) square meters.

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Count the exposed faces on the four vertical sides, then the faces seen from directly above
Each of the four sides shows \(6\) exposed faces, and looking straight down covers the full \(3 \times 3\) footprint of top faces
